products.description: A moisturizing eye cream formulated to reduce puffiness and improve visible signs of aging. Built on a patented squalane-ceramide complex that recreates the skin's own lipid structure, it nourishes and moisturizes the delicate eye area while helping correct discoloration. Low-molecular hyaluronic acid, hydrolyzed egg-shell membrane and pearl proteins deliver deep moisturizing and rejuvenation, while Saxifraga and Alpha-Arbutin improve microcirculation and normalize pigmentation.

Helps relieve the appearance of under-eye puffiness
